definitions: A series of Intel microprocessors designed for laptops and other portable devices, featuring integrated neural processing units (NPUs) for AI acceleration and improved power efficiency.
A brand of high-performance, low-power processors from Intel, often found in premium ultrabooks and AI PCs.
examples: The new laptop is powered by an Intel Core Ultra.
Intel Core Ultra processors offer significant AI capabilities.
Many manufacturers are adopting Intel Core Ultra for their next-gen devices.
